newsitem.title: FRANCE: French parliament to debate '98 budget from Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: French parliament to debate '98 budget from Oct 14.

text.p: The French National Assembly will begin the first reading of the 1998 budget on October 14 and complete it on November 20, the Assembly's bureau decided on Tuesday.
The lower house will first debate the revenue side on October 14-17, before a line-by-line reading of ministries' expenditure from October 21 to November 20.

The government has already said that parliament will hold a special session from mid-September to debate a 1997 mini-budget in the light of an independent audit of public finances due to be completed in mid-July.
